items.title: Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: So I said to Grandmama, you know, I sure would like to have that cornet.

ctx.x: That’s like a message from somewhere.

Yeah. So I said to Grandmama, you know, I sure would like to have that cornet. And you know God bless her, you can imagine, we’re talking 1947, ’48. I don’t know how she saved the pennies but she went and got that thing for me. And the rest is history.
That’s really interesting. And you must have seen some pictures to connect what you were hearing on the 78s to what the instrument was, or maybe you asked around, like what is that sound?
